question: What were the total sales for today?
sql: SELECT SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalSales, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE CAST(InvoiceDate AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND Status != 'Cancelled'

question: Show me the top 10 best-selling items this month
sql: SELECT TOP 10 si.LongName, SUM(si.Quantity) AS TotalQty, SUM(si.ItemTotalAmount) AS TotalRevenue FROM Rista_SaleItems si JOIN Rista_SaleInvoices inv ON si.InvoiceID = inv.InvoiceID WHERE MONTH(inv.InvoiceDate) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND YEAR(inv.InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND inv.Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY si.LongName ORDER BY TotalQty DESC

question: What is the revenue breakdown by payment method?
sql: SELECT p.Mode AS PaymentMethod, SUM(p.Amount) AS TotalAmount, COUNT(DISTINCT p.InvoiceID) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SalePayments p JOIN Rista_SaleInvoices inv ON p.InvoiceID = inv.InvoiceID WHERE inv.Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY p.Mode ORDER BY TotalAmount DESC

question: How many orders were delivered vs dine-in last week?
sql: SELECT DeliveryMode, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount, SUM(TotalAmount) AS Revenue FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE InvoiceDate >= DATEADD(day, -7, GETDATE()) AND Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY DeliveryMode

question: Which branch had the highest sales this month?
sql: SELECT TOP 5 branchCode, SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalSales, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE MONTH(InvoiceDate) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND YEAR(InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY branchCode ORDER BY TotalSales DESC

question: Show average order value by channel
sql: SELECT Channel, AVG(TotalAmount) AS AvgOrderValue, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY Channel ORDER BY AvgOrderValue DESC

question: What items were sold in category Beverages today?
sql: SELECT si.LongName, SUM(si.Quantity) AS TotalQty, SUM(si.ItemTotalAmount) AS Revenue FROM Rista_SaleItems si JOIN Rista_SaleInvoices inv ON si.InvoiceID = inv.InvoiceID WHERE si.CategoryName = 'Beverages' AND CAST(inv.InvoiceDate AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND inv.Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY si.LongName ORDER BY TotalQty DESC

question: Show total discount given this month
sql: SELECT SUM(TotalDiscountAmount) AS TotalDiscount, COUNT(*) AS InvoicesWithDiscount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE TotalDiscountAmount > 0 AND MONTH(InvoiceDate) = MONTH(GETDATE()) AND YEAR(InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) AND Status != 'Cancelled'

question: List invoices with their customer names and total amounts for today
sql: SELECT TOP 100 inv.InvoiceNumber, c.Name AS CustomerName, inv.TotalAmount, inv.DeliveryMode, inv.Status FROM Rista_SaleInvoices inv LEFT JOIN Rista_SaleCustomers c ON inv.InvoiceID = c.InvoiceID WHERE CAST(inv.InvoiceDate AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date) ORDER BY inv.InvoiceDate DESC

question: What is the hourly sales trend for today?
sql: SELECT DATEPART(hour, InvoiceDate) AS Hour, COUNT(*) AS OrderCount, SUM(TotalAmount) AS Revenue FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE CAST(InvoiceDate AS date) = CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY DATEPART(hour, InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Hour

question: List top 5 branches by earnings last year
sql: SELECT TOP 5 branchCode, SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalEarnings, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 AND Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY branchCode ORDER BY TotalEarnings DESC

question: What were total sales last year?
sql: SELECT SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalSales, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 AND Status != 'Cancelled'

question: Show earnings for October last year
sql: SELECT SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalEarnings, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE MONTH(InvoiceDate) = 10 AND YEAR(InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 AND Status != 'Cancelled'

question: Give me earnings by branch for October last year
sql: SELECT branchCode, SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalEarnings, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE MONTH(InvoiceDate) = 10 AND YEAR(InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 AND Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY branchCode ORDER BY TotalEarnings DESC

question: Give me earnings of all Pune region branches for October last year
sql: SELECT branchCode, SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalEarnings, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE branchCode IN ('PUNE001','PUNE002','PUNE003') AND MONTH(InvoiceDate) = 10 AND YEAR(InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 AND Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY branchCode ORDER BY TotalEarnings DESC

question: Compare monthly sales for this year vs last year
sql: SELECT MONTH(InvoiceDate) AS Month, YEAR(InvoiceDate) AS Year, SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalSales FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE YEAR(InvoiceDate) IN (YEAR(GETDATE()), YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1) AND Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY YEAR(InvoiceDate), MONTH(InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Year, Month

question: What were the sales for Q1 last year?
sql: SELECT MONTH(InvoiceDate) AS Month, SUM(TotalAmount) AS TotalSales, COUNT(*) AS InvoiceCount FROM Rista_SaleInvoices WHERE MONTH(InvoiceDate) IN (1,2,3) AND YEAR(InvoiceDate) = YEAR(GETDATE()) - 1 AND Status != 'Cancelled' GROUP BY MONTH(InvoiceDate) ORDER BY Month
